subtitle.zh: NEXUS：造物循环｜叙事向概念游戏场景设计

description.zh: 以工业流水线构建一个自我复制的机械文明，在六个生产空间中展开关于创造、服从与循环的叙事。
description.en: A self-replicating mechanical civilisation built around an assembly line, unfolding a narrative of creation, obedience, and circulation across six production spaces.

kind.zh: 叙事向概念游戏场景设计

coverAlt.zh: 青绿色金属机械文明场景，流水线连接六个生产装置。
coverAlt.en: A teal metallic mechanical civilisation with six production systems connected by an assembly line.

role.zh: 概念场景、三维建模与渲染

stage.zh: 概念设计与场景影像呈现

deliverables.zh: 世界观、机械角色、模块化场景、白模、渲染与场景影片
deliverables.en: Worldbuilding, mechanical characters, modular environments, clay studies, renders, and environment film

overview.zh: NEXUS 是一个围绕“自我复制”展开的机械文明概念设计项目。在这个世界中，人类早已离开生产体系。机械兔与机械猪以及其他人工生命接管了整个社会，它们负责建造、维护并扩张属于自己的文明。所有个体都诞生于同一套生产机制，并在成长过程中不断参与下一代机械生命的创造。
overview.en: NEXUS is a mechanical-civilisation concept design project built around self-replication. In this world, humans have long left the production system. Mechanical rabbits, pigs, and other artificial beings have taken over society, building, maintaining, and expanding their own civilisation. Every individual emerges from the same production mechanism and, as it grows, participates in creating the next generation of mechanical life.

paragraphs.zh: 这里是机械文明的心脏。无数资源、劳动成果，甚至被淘汰的个体都会被投入熔炉，压缩成维持世界运转的能量脉冲。它们沿着管道流向各个生产区域，驱动着下一轮生命的诞生。
paragraphs.en: This is the heart of the mechanical civilisation. Resources, the products of labour, and even discarded individuals are fed into the furnace and compressed into pulses of energy that sustain the world. They travel through pipes to every production area, driving the birth of the next generation.

paragraphs.zh: 能量核心不断释放指令，机械臂按照既定程序组装新的生命。机械兔、机械猪与其他生产个体在此被制造出来，从零件到身份，一切都早已被系统决定。
paragraphs.en: The energy core constantly issues instructions as robotic arms assemble new life according to a fixed program. Mechanical rabbits, pigs, and other production units are manufactured here. From their components to their identities, everything has already been determined by the system.

paragraphs.zh: 初生个体将在这里接受改造与校准。系统会修复缺陷、强化结构，并植入统一的行为逻辑，让它们成为更加高效的生产工具。每一次“升级”都在接近完美，也在远离自我。
paragraphs.en: Newly created individuals undergo modification and calibration here. The system repairs faults, strengthens structures, and implants a unified behavioural logic, turning them into more efficient production tools. Every “upgrade” brings them closer to perfection and further from themselves.

paragraphs.zh: 位于文明中央的监察核心持续注视着一切。每一次移动、每一次工作、每一次停顿都会被记录并转化为评级数据，决定个体未来的命运。它从不命令任何人，因为所有人都早已学会服从。
paragraphs.en: The surveillance core at the centre of civilisation watches everything. Every movement, task, and pause is recorded and converted into rating data that determines an individual’s future. It never gives orders, because everyone has already learned to obey.

paragraphs.zh: 当个体通过所有测试后，系统会为其注入情绪与人格模块。快乐、恐惧、期待与归属感被编写成程序，成为驱动它们继续工作的另一种能源。
paragraphs.en: After an individual passes every test, the system installs emotional and personality modules. Happiness, fear, anticipation, and belonging are written into programs, becoming another source of energy that keeps it working.

paragraphs.zh: 这里是评级体系的终点。监控屏幕会回放个体的一生，而巨大的机械怪兽负责执行最终审判。未达到标准的个体将被吞噬、拆解，并重新回到生产循环之中。
paragraphs.en: This is the endpoint of the rating system. Monitoring screens replay an individual’s life while a giant mechanical creature delivers the final judgement. Those who fail to meet the standard are devoured, dismantled, and returned to the production cycle.
